channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Hegseth kicks off ‘Send Me Tour’ amid Iran war backlash
item.description: US Secretary of Defence Pete Hegseth has kicked off his ‘Send Me Tour’ in Texas amid Iran war backlash.

item.title: Iran says conditions to re-engage in talks, end war sent to US via Qatar
item.description: Mohsen Rezaei, secretary of Iran’s Supreme National Security Council, tells Al Jazeera Tehran awaiting Trump response.

item.title: Israel targets paramedics in southern Lebanon
item.description: Two back-to-back Israeli air strikes hit Nabatieh in Lebanon, while a third strike targeted an ambulance team.

item.title: Syria says blast at military site in Deir Az Zor killed 11
item.description: Syrian army holds funeral for soldiers killed in ammunition blast in town of Ayyash, in western Deir Az Zor, on Friday.

item.title: An unaffordable car market highlights Iran’s cost-of-living crisis
item.description: Some officials and state media have long openly described the industry as a ‘mafia’ system.

item.title: Taiwan flexes military capabilities ahead of Trump-Xi talks
item.description: Taiwan has staged live-fire drills with missiles and attack drones as Donald Trump prepares to host China’s Xi Jinping.

item.title: Houthis say they targeted Saudi capital with ballistic missiles
item.description: A reported strike on a fuel depot at Riyadh airport caused delays on Saturday, as conflict between Saudi Arabia and the Yemen-based group continues.

item.title: Grim discoveries of murdered women spark fear in South Africa
item.description: Dineo Motapane is one of nine recent victims whose deaths have left a nation traumatised over the level of violence against women.

item.title: At least 21 killed after vehicle loaded with explosives rams Pakistan mosque
item.description: A four-year-old child is among those killed in the attack, during which gunmen also opened fire on a police facility.

item.title: Saudi Arabia issues first air raid alerts for Riyadh since Houthis escalated attacks
item.description: Residents later received the all-clear after explosions were reported in the capital.
